purpose: Deterministic regression assumptions for the v0.3 assurance kernel
claim_boundary: These values are not measurements, vendor specifications, purchasing recommendations, or hardware performance claims.
assumptions: bounded payload and arm pose used only for conservative regression calculations
constant drivetrain efficiency and rolling resistance at the checked point
unverified arm-motor continuous ratings and reducer efficiencies are conservative static transmission-screen inputs, not vendor specifications
battery usable energy already includes an assumed reserve

simulation_dynamics.claim_boundary: Wheel mass and inertia are simulator-only assumed parameters until replaced by verified component or test evidence.
